readme: R300 browser-captured labels (2026-07-25, main session, Brad's Chrome). Each row transcribed from a photographed/rendered nutrition panel; provenance URL recorded. These complete the 3-item capture-worklist.json.

items.notes: EU-import 600ml bottle label (barcode 0711844110618): per-100ml column read directly (444 kcal, fat 0.6, carb 108, sugars 79, protein 1.9, salt 5.5); per-serving derived as the label's printed 15 ml portion = x0.15. 15 ml at syrup density ~1.33 = 20 g serving_grams. Atwater on per-100ml: 445 vs 444 printed. US-jar FDA panel not available on any fetchable listing; flagged for auditor.
items.source: label photo https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/071/184/411/0618/nutrition_en.12.full.jpg (values column read from photo; per-portion column cropped in photo)
items.verify_source: derived-from-label-per-100ml; auditor should re-check if a US FDA panel surfaces

items.brand: Lee Kum Kee (Chili Bean Sauce Toban Djan)
items.notes: Flat FDA panel, read in full: Serv 1 tsp (6 g), ~37 servings per 8 oz (226 g) jar, cal 5, fat 0g, sodium 280mg (12% DV), carb 1g, sugars <1g, protein 0g, vit A 2%. Resolves the FDC contradiction: real household measure is 1 tsp = 6 g (FDC branded row claimed 1 Tbsp = 6 g). Same product sold as 8 oz and 13 oz jars; panel from 8 oz jar image.
items.verify_source: full panel readable; Atwater 4 vs 5 ok (rounding)
